card.name: Audio file format details in listings
card.fires_on: Spaces and digits inside audio file specifications such as 'MP3 Mono 44kHz 128Kbps (CBR)', especially the gap and numbers after the kHz value. Weaker on a few odd spots like a closing parenthesis or a space before a statistic.

modes.label: Audio specs
modes.description: Spaces, digits and 'bps' within a podcast or audio file line giving length, size and bitrate.

modes.label: Scattered other spots
modes.description: Occasional punctuation or spaces in web text, such as a closing parenthesis in a page note or a space before a percentage.

card.plain: It lights up on the technical numbers in audio file descriptions, like bitrate and sampling rate.
